support.quote: At the top of the ranking for the world's largest employers is India's Ministry of Defence.

Hamburg: With 2.92 million personnel in its staff, India’s Ministry of Defence is the world’s biggest employer, says a report adding that this includes combined active service personnel, reservists and civilian staff.
The world's largest employer is India's Ministry of Defence with 2.99 million people working for them.
The latest information from the U.S. retail giant put the figure at a massive 2.30 million.
With fiscal year 2022 revenue of $573 billion, Walmart employs approximately 2.3 million associates worldwide.
UK's National Health Service (NHS), the second-largest single-payer healthcare system in the world, has a workforce of a whopping 1.38 million and ranks seventh on the list.
The NHS is the country’s biggest employer and the largest employer in Europe, as well as being one of the largest employers globally by headcount.
Foxconn, the world's largest technology manufacturer and service provider, has 1.29 million people in its employment and is the eighth biggest employer in the world.
(a) The total number of regular employees currently working in the Railways is 12,52,347 as on 31.03.2021.
With more than 1.2 million employees, it is the ninth-largest employer of the world and the second largest employer of India.

The park produces the bulk of Apple's iPhone line and is sometimes referred to as "iPhone City".
Number of employees : 648,492

Wording now asks about Statista's listing, which is accurate.
